actual_cards.oracle_text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a noncreature, nonland card from it. That player discards that card.

coordinator_direction: F02 AMEND_REQUIRED: Duress reveals chosen player's hand public to ALL while it occurs (701.20a). Do not claim only controller sees revealed hand.
